raw_segments.text: No need to be nervous," the latter blurted out.
"'Radia has been ill for the last five days and delirious for three, but now he is recovering
This is his doctor, who has just had a look at him.
I am a comrade of Radia's like him, formerly a student, and now I am nursing him.
So don't you take any notice of us but go on with your business.'"
